name: voice-over
description: Spoken turn-end notifications for Claude Code, streamed through pdg.

name.title: Spoken prefix
name.description: Prefix spoken before every announcement. Set to an empty value to omit it.

command.title: TTS command
command.description: Command and fixed arguments. The announcement is appended as the last argument, or piped when input is stdin.

input.title: How the announcement reaches the command
input.description: arg appends it as the last argument; stdin pipes it.

maxWords.title: Maximum words
maxWords.description: Maximum words in the whole announcement.

maxFirstSentenceWords.title: Maximum words in the first sentence
maxFirstSentenceWords.description: pdg starts streaming audio after the first sentence, so it must stay short.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Load the plugin without announcing when turned off.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Write a dim line to the transcript for each queued, dropped, and spoken announcement.
